features.heading: SSL for Every SMB Scenario — One Platform
features.intro: From basic blogs to high-volume ecommerce, Hostopia's SSL portfolio covers the full range of SMB security needs — with trusted certificate authority backing, branded management, and no infrastructure for you to build.

cards.title: Domain Validation (DV SSL)
cards.body: Entry-level encryption with domain validation and a static site seal. Ideal for blogs, informational sites, and SMBs just getting online who need the padlock without complexity.

cards.title: Organization Validation (OV SSL)
cards.body: Company-validated encryption with a dynamic site seal and higher warranty. Recommended for commercial and public-facing business sites that want verified trust signals.

cards.title: Extended Validation (EV SSL)
cards.body: The highest level of validation with full company verification and premium warranty. Built for ecommerce, login-heavy apps, and any site where trust drives revenue.

cards.title: Wildcard SSL
cards.body: Secures a domain and all subdomains (store.example.com, mail.example.com, blog.example.com) with a single certificate — reducing complexity and cost for growing businesses.

cards.title: Trusted Certificate Authorities
cards.body: All certificates issued through recognized, globally trusted CAs — with the browser compatibility and warranty backing SMB customers need, delivered entirely under your brand.

cards.title: Branded Management & Renewals
cards.body: Issuance, installation guidance, renewals, and expiration alerts all run through your partner platform — so customers never see Hostopia, and you never lose a renewal to a missed email.

partnerAdvantage.heading: The Highest-Attach Add-On in Your Portfolio
partnerAdvantage.intro: SSL is essential, low-friction, and bundles with everything. Every website, every store, every hosting plan is an SSL opportunity — with recurring revenue that compounds with your base.

items.title: Bundle with everything
items.body: SSL pairs naturally with websites, ecommerce, hosting, and email. Bundle it into your core plans as a default, or sell it as a standalone security add-on — either way, attach rates stay high because the product is genuinely required.

items.title: Drive predictable recurring revenue
items.body: Annual certificate renewals create high-margin, recurring subscription revenue with minimal support overhead. Once a site is encrypted, the customer stays encrypted — and you keep collecting.

items.title: Position as a security advisor, not just a host
items.body: Offering SSL alongside your digital services signals to SMBs that you care about their security, not just their uptime. That trust deepens the relationship, drives retention, and opens the door to the higher-value security products that follow.

items.title: Enterprise trust, partner-level margins
items.body: You resell globally trusted CAs with warranty backing, browser compatibility, and compliance support built in — all delivered under your brand with none of the issuance infrastructure to operate yourself.
